description: One HTML page becomes one frame-perfect video. A deterministic motion-graphics framework for people and coding agents: write the page in HTML, CSS, Web Animations, SVG and canvas, render an mp4.
rules: A film is films/<name>/page.html. Time is the seek, never the clock: write CSS keyframes, element.animate() or window.seek(t) as a pure function of t.
A frame may never depend on wall-clock time, timers, state between frames or an unseeded random. This is the load-bearing invariant of the framework.
Read AGENTS.md for the page contract before writing a page.
Never write an em dash (U+2014) in on-screen text.
Run bin/vawe dev <page> for a draft, then bin/vawe critique <page> in a session that did not write the page.
